name: Calendesk
description: B2B booking + payments + client portal for therapists, psychologists, coaches, lawyers, beauty/fitness — white-label, subscription packages, API-first. Polish-founded, bootstrapped since 2020.

mentions.evidence: ~$21.5k MRR, 376 active subscriptions, ~$37.0k L30, ~$1.13M all-time, founded May 2020, Poland. Last sync Sep 30, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Country/vertical booking for regulated service pros (therapy, legal, tutoring) still underserved vs Calendly-generic.

whyItPrints: Service pros already schedule and take deposits every day. Calendesk owns that workflow at ~$79–$147/mo instead of inventing a new category.
